items.body:
Adds five entries (MG U9 EV, two Xpeng X9, two Leapmotor B05) to `vehicles.json`; `updated` set to 2026-11-18. `format.mjs` and `validate.mjs` pass.

| Change | Old | New | Source and exact figures |
|---|---|---|---|
| MG MGU9 EV (ute, `mg-u9-ev-2026`) | not listed | 102.2 kWh, 430 km, 115 kW DC, 11 kW AC, 20-80% 42 min | [MG Australia](https://www.mgmotor.com.au/vehicles/mgu9-ev): "Available Now", 102.2kWh LFP, up to 430km WLTP, 115kW peak, 11kW AC, 20-80% 42 min |
| Xpeng X9 2WD (van, `xpeng-x9-2wd-2026`) | not listed | 94.8 kWh, 535 km, 542 kW DC, 11 kW AC, 10-80% 12 min | [The Driven, 2026-07-21](https://thedriven.io/2026/07/21/xpeng-launches-x9-luxury-people-mover-in-australia-priced-from-89900/): $89,900 plus on-road, 94.8 kWh LFP, 535 km, up to 542 kW |
| Xpeng X9 AWD (`xpeng-x9-awd-2026`) | not listed | 110 kWh, 580 km, 542 kW DC, 11 kW AC, 10-80% 12 min | Same article: from $109,900 plus on-road, "110 NCM battery", 580 km. [Xpeng Australia](https://www.xpeng.com/au) also shows the X9 as a current model, "up to 580km", "12 min" |
| Leapmotor B05 Style (`leapmotor-b05-style-2026`) | not listed | 56.2 kWh, 401 km, 174 kW DC, 11 kW AC, 30-80% 16 min | [The Driven, 2026-07-02](https://thedriven.io/2026/07/02/new-leapmotor-b05-electric-hatchback-to-land-in-australia-from-35990-driveway/): $35,990 drive-away, 56.2 kWh LFP, up to 401 km, up to 174 kW |
| Leapmotor B05 Design LR (`leapmotor-b05-design-lr-2026`) | not listed | 67.1 kWh, 482 km, 174 kW DC, 11 kW AC, 30-80% 18 min | Same article: $39,990, 67.1 kWh LFP, up to 482 km |

**Not sure about**
- Usable battery is the published gross figure, marked "est." in `source`. The X9 AWD article gives "110 NCM battery" with no unit, so I read it as 110 kWh.
- The X9 542 kW peak looks very high, but both The Driven and the existing G6 entries (431-451 kW) are in the same range. The X9 figure is the article's, not the maker's.
- Leapmotor's Australian domain is parked, so the B05 figures and prices come only from The Driven's launch report. The MG U9 price is only in MG's configurator, so it isn't in the entry.
- **Not added, kept as candidates:** Deepal E07 (maker page has only a placeholder price and no order statement), Hongqi E-HS9 (price "below $150,000", not final; deliveries from 2027-01-18), Avatr 07L/06T (expressions of interest only, due 2027), Chery E5 (no maker spec sheet could be read).
- **Incomplete this run:** the 12-make re-check (step 2) was not done. Most maker sites returned 403, a parked domain or a TLS failure, so I marked no make as re-checked. The next run should start with Abarth, Alfa Romeo, Audi, BMW, BYD, Cadillac, Cupra, Deepal, Denza, Fiat, Ford and GAC. ROVER, BITRE (its download failed) and the Green Vehicle Guide's new-vehicle list were also not read.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code]((claude.com/redacted)
